title: Retiming cubic Gaussian layouts below the limiting crossing-cover coefficient

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. Let L(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee.leading. Let R(n) be the sum of the monomials in guarantee.remainder.terms, each coefficient times n^exponent*(log2 n)^log_exponent*(log2 log2 n)^loglog_exponent; an empty sum is zero. There exists N such that C_B2(f_n)>=L(n)-R(n) for every integer n>=N. All remainder coefficients are the exact declared constants. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total language L of proof.md section 1, decided at every length N by one fixed evaluator A. If N<16 output 0. Else k is the largest integer with 4^k<=N, t=2^k, m0=floor((N-t)/(t+1)), m=m0 if m0 is odd and m=m0-1 otherwise, l=N-t-m-t*m; if m<1 output 0. Bits 1..t define R(W)=W^t+sum_{v<t} x_{v+1}W^v and bits t+1..t+m define Q(Z)=Z^m+sum_{u<m} x_{t+u+1}Z^u over F_2; if R or Q fails the exact irreducibility test of proof.md (X^(2^d)=X mod P, and gcd(P,X^(2^d')-X)=1 for every divisor d' of d=deg P with d'<d) output 0. Otherwise the next t*m bits c_{u,v} (bit number t+m+v*m+u+1) give z=sum c_{u,v}Z^uW^v in the field E=(F_2[Z]/(Q))[W]/(R) with 2^(tm) elements, the last l bits are ignored, and the output is 1 iff z^e=1 for e=sum_{j=0}^{t-1} 2^(m*j). All t+m+l prefix and leftover bits are counted in N; R and Q are input, not advice.","guarantee":{"kind":"eventual_lower_bound","leading":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"10000000000000000000000000000000","numerator":"48270900384055950810649810365841"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"remainder":{"kind":"explicit","terms":[]}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"10000000000000000000000000000000","numerator":"48270900384055950810649810365841"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"The single fixed total language L defined in proof.md Section 1 is in P and in NP with empty witnesses. For some integer N_0>=256 and every integer N>=N_0, in the full B2 model at entire input length N, C_B2(L_N)>=(48270900384055950810649810365841/10000000000000000000000000000000)N. The explicit remainder is zero. The proof establishes the all-length coefficient 157661891605789416085437344534339/32661891605789416085437344534339 with one uniform o(N) loss and uses a strictly positive coefficient margin for the eventual theorem. The same inequality implies the declared finite projection with exponent one.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v2"}

experiments.purpose: Prove the exact order-83 Gaussian series bound Gamma_83<0.130647566423167664341749378137356, bound the even truncation below, and certify the two-private-edge sum in the structural improvement. The 127-node quadrature on [0,4] uses a banded Gaussian derivative envelope, paired positive completions and 224-bit exact sparse interval contractions. The manuscript supplies the additional uniform 10^(-14) saving.
